attempted_claim: Let C be an irreducible complex projective plane curve of degree 6, rational, whose only non-nodal singularities are exactly two ordinary cusps of analytic type A2 (each delta-invariant 1, Tjurina number 2, in distinct positions) and whose remaining singularities are exactly 8 ordinary nodes. Impose passage through 15 points in general position in P^2. Using the relative (log) Gromov-Witten degeneration of P^2 along the normal-crossing divisor of two distinct lines L1 union L2 (total class 6L, contact orders partitioning 6 along each line and a stated tangency profile at the intersection point) with its full degeneration-ledger sum, plus torus localization on the expanded-target moduli spaces, prove finiteness and transversality under the 15 point conditions and determine with proof the exact finite enumerative number N(6,2xA2) counting such bicuspidal curves (each unordered cusp pair counted once). A complete answer is a proved nonnegative integer value together with the certified ledger sum and localization contributions yielding it.
claim_type: exact finite enumerative number with certified ledger
decisive_failure: The pass lacked the unstated corner tangency profile at L1 cap L2, relative and rubber invariant tables, equivariant integration tooling, computer algebra systems, and network references, so neither the degeneration ledger nor transversality could be certified within the one-hour target-only pass.
